notes.title: PATCH NOTES #2.0.2
notes.content:
Hello to all strategists,

We’re thrilled to present the new features and fixes in this Patch Notes. Thank you again for your feedback, which allows us to improve your gaming experience and address any issues encountered.

Here’s the list of the various updates and fixes we’ve implemented:

[h2][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2]
🔥 [b]The return of the Ladder:[/b]
You asked for it, and we’re excited to announce that the Ladder and rankings are back! All rankings will be reset, so everyone will start at "Recruit IV" and work their way up to the ultimate rank of "Warlord!" Get ready to compete against each other, climb the leaderboard, and become the greatest strategist the Lands of Noara have ever seen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/4f1465ef85dea4143e2c453bfa925a4c33aeb4c5.gif[/img]

🌊 [b]Skins:[/b]
All [u]Abyssal[/u] skins, previously available only through Sarme Coins or special rewards, can now be unlocked using Khinas, the in-game currency you earn as rewards at the end of your matches.
Additionally, all [u]Albinos[/u] skins, which were previously unavailable, can now be purchased with Sarme Coins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/6f9cf306880608ec1914326ee3bd3cf52946a638.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
Here’s the list of bugs fixed in this update:
[b]Mastok:[/b] There was an issue where Mastok’s healing passive would loop until the end of the turn, making him invincible and disrupting gameplay. This issue has been resolved.

[b]Caste Display:[/b] During the management phase, the second caste on the right in the character information sheet was replaced by a white square. They’ve now been restored to their rightful place.

[b]AI Mode Selection:[/b] When selecting the game mode against AI, the game could remember the last mode used and launch it instead of the selected mode. This bug has been fixed.

[b]Mana Albinos Skin Texture:[/b] The Mana Albinos skin texture wasn’t displaying correctly and appeared identical to the original Mana skin. This issue has been resolved, and the skin now displays as intended.

[b]Menu and Profile Icon:[/b] In the menu, clicking multiple times on the profile icon caused an hourglass to spin endlessly until a match was launched or the game was restarted. This issue has been corrected.

The Atypique team thanks you for your support and valuable feedback. Keep sharing your ideas and impressions. See you soon on the Lands of Noara!

The Atypique Studio Team.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES #2.0.1
notes.content:
Hello Strategists!

Today, we are happy to introduce the new features and adjustments in this latest version of Noara: The Conspiracy. Thanks to your valuable feedback, we’ve worked hard to enhance your gaming experience and improve several aspects.

Here’s what’s new:

[h2][b]Custom Games[/b]:[/h2]
Missing the ability to create custom games? Not anymore!
You can now create a custom game visible to everyone, allowing you to invite your friends or challenge other strategists.
Additionally, if a player is missing, you’ll have the option to fill the spot with BOTS. Custom games are now the best way to train and refine your strategies.

[h2][b]Improved AI[/b]:[/h2]
Speaking of BOTS, we’ve updated the AI to provide more varied and dynamic behaviors. When you play with or against it, the AI will now deploy a wider range of strategies and behaviors. These improvements make matches against AI less repetitive and offer better training opportunities.

[h2][b]Health Bar Readability[/b]:[/h2]
Say goodbye to confusion—your battles will now be smoother and easier to read!
In the previous version, health bars were too far from their respective units, which could make them hard to track during large skirmishes or depending on the camera angle.
We’ve brought them closer to the units, ensuring a clearer view of your troops’ health in any situation.

[h2][b]The Ladder[/b]:[/h2]
The in-game ladder has been temporarily disabled and will be back very soon. Don’t worry—this interruption allows us to ensure an accurate and updated leaderboard. You’ll soon be able to climb (or reclaim) the ranks once again!

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b]:[/h2]
We appreciate all the bug reports you’ve sent our way. Some issues are still awaiting fixes, but rest assured, they’re on their way!
Here’s a list of the bugs we’ve already resolved:
[list]
[] Akuyandi and Kalinga can now be deployed without triggering their bonuses multiple times. This issue was disrupting game balance and could even cause crashes.
[] It’s no longer possible to sell the units provided at the start of the game multiple times, which previously gave a significant economic advantage and was, let’s face it, pretty unfair.
[*] The in-game chat is back! You can now communicate with your ally again to plan tactics in real time and coordinate your actions more effectively.
[/list]

[h2][b]About the Ladder[/b]:[/h2]
The in-game ladder has been temporarily disabled and will be back very soon. Don’t worry—this interruption allows us to ensure an accurate and updated leaderboard. You’ll soon be able to climb (or reclaim) the ranks once again!

That wraps up this patch notes overview!
We want to thank you for your loyalty during this first month since reopening, as well as for your invaluable feedback, which helps us improve the game.
We hope you’ll enjoy these updates, and the entire team wishes you a wonderful holiday season.

See you soon on the lands of Noara, may the goddess soothe you!

The Atypique Team

notes.title: HOTFIX #7
notes.content:
Hello, strategists!

Some of you have experienced issues with server selection when creating an account or logging into the game. Due to network issues or VPN usage, players were sometimes automatically placed on a random server.

This made it difficult to switch servers from the login screen, preventing players from teaming up with their friends and fully enjoying the Noara experience.

Good news: this issue has now been fixed!
From now on, when you launch [b]NOARA: THE CONSPIRACY[/b], the login screen will let you choose the server that best suits your location. This makes it easy to switch servers and join the same one as your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/e3d670d599cf9cedba5ee4b1f51f951d86402375.gif[/img]

Please note that your last selected server will also be remembered, so you won’t need to reselect it every time you log in.

Other adjustment: 
From now on, after completing the tutorial, new players will only need to play one match against the AI (instead of two initially). This will allow all new players to join public matches more quickly.

The Noara team apologizes for the inconvenience.
See you soon in-game!

notes.title: MAJOR ANNOUNCEMENT | SERVERS ARE BACK OPEN 🔥
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First and foremost, we want to thank you for your unwavering support throughout this journey, and we also want to sincerely apologize for the long wait.
But today is a momentous day for all strategists in the Lands of Noara! We’re thrilled to announce that [b]the Silo 2v2 mode is making its big comeback[/b], accompanied by a host of exciting new features!

Let’s dive right in!

[list]
[*][u][b]The return of the Silo 2v2 mode[/b][/u]: After experimenting with various formats, your feedback confirmed what we always knew—the Silo mode is the essence of Noara, delivering the perfect balance between strategy and fun. Over the past months, we’ve worked hard to optimize it and make it even more immersive.

For those unfamiliar, the rules are simple: destroy the enemy bastion before they destroy yours!
Team up with your ally, build a strong economy, recruit powerful units with unique synergies, and outsmart your opponents using Noara: The Conspiracy’s unique real-time mechanics.

The return of Silo mode marks a major milestone for the game’s future, and we can’t wait to see the creative new strategies you’ll come up with!

[*][u][b]A fresh start to every game[/b][/u]: We’ve redesigned the beginning of each match to make it more dynamic and beginner-friendly. Gone are the days of starting directly on the management interface: now, every player will begin with two random units chosen from Pirh Baffeur, Kapal, or Krogz.

This new start lets you jump straight into the action, playing right from the first seconds in-game. Plus, it opens up new early-game strategies and helps guide your unit recruitment decisions for the rest of the match.

[*][u][b]A new caste[/b][/u]: Introducing the Pirhs! This new caste brings a unique gameplay style centered around growth and collective synergy.
As you deploy Pirhs on the battlefield, reaching key thresholds (4, 10, 15 units), your Pirhs will heal and gain increased maximum health.
At the ultimate threshold—20 deployed Pirhs—each player in your team will receive an exclusive unit on their bench: the Pirh Rageux.

[*][u][b]The Pirh Rageux[/b][/u]: This new unit is more than just a classic Pirh tank—it combines strength, resilience, and mobility. Capable of quickly closing the gap to enemy units or even their bastion, the Pirh Rageux can deliver devastating surprises and turn the tide of battle!

[*][u][b]A brand-new tutorial[/b][/u]: To help new players get the hang of Noara, we’ve completely revamped the tutorial! Guided by the ever-reliable Gakpé, you’ll learn the basics of the game step by step.
The tutorial is divided into multiple chapters and must be completed before jumping into normal matches. It’s a perfect opportunity for everyone to learn or rediscover the rich gameplay of the Silo mode!

[*][u][b]AI Mode[/b][/u]: Whether solo or with your ally, you can now play with or against AI opponents. This is a great way to have fun, train, and refine your strategies by exploring all the synergies and bonuses that the castes offer before heading into normal games!

[*][u][b]New interfaces[/b][/u]: The main menu has been completely redesigned to be clearer and more modern. Additionally, the in-game management turn interface has also been revamped. Both have been improved to be more intuitive, with all the essential information right at your fingertips.

[*][u][b]Improved lighting[/b][/u]: The beauty of the Lands of Noara has been elevated thanks to meticulous work on the in-game lighting. The map’s various areas are now brighter, enhancing both the gameplay experience and the immersion in Noara’s universe.
[/list]
We hope these updates will delight the strategists in you. But this is only the beginning! [b]We’ve got even more surprises in store for the months ahead.[/b]

See you soon on the battlefield,
The Noara Team

notes.title: Patch Notes #1.7.0.9
notes.content:
Hello strategists!

You have already had a small glimpse on our YouTube channel of what this new Patch #1.7.0.9 was going to contain but today it's time to discover everything in details!

Enjoy your reading!

[h1]New Adalar Units![/h1]
We  added 4 new playable Adalar units for free! They are not with their final 3D models but it will allow you to test new strategies and deck compositions! Let's introduce them:

[h2]Barada[/h2]
[b]Passive[/b] - Sadism: Barada is healed every time he deals effects damage (like poison) to a visible unit.

[b]Q[/b] - Toxic arrows: Inflicts elemental damage as well as poison to the affected unit.

[b]E[/b] - Tranquilizing arrow:
[u]On himself:[/u]
Barada becomes immune to crowd control effects.
[u]On ennemies:[/u]
If thrown at a target, it puts it to sleep which prevents it from performing actions. The unit wakes up if it takes damage.

[b]R[/b] - Lethal Gas: Sends a gas bomb into the area that ignite all effects of the affected units and they instantly take damage.

[h2]Trixie[/h2]
[b]Passive[/b] - Revenge: When Trixie dies, her mount avenges her and deals damage to the unit that killed her.

[b]Q[/b] - Bloody whip: Inflicts elemental damage as well as bleeding to the affected unit.
If the unit is bleeding, Trixie jumps on it and inflicts damage and bleeding to the adjacent units.

[b]E[/b] - Strangulation: Inflicts elemental damage, immobilizes the target, and reduces the damage dealt.

[b]R[/b] - Wild Charm: Charms the targeted unit. The target unit follows Trixie for the duration of the charm, or until it takes damage.

[h2]Maoro[/h2]
[b]Passive[/b] - Webbed prey: Maoro deals additional damage to units affected by a control effect.

[b]Q[/b] - Sledgehammer blow: Inflicts physical damage and pushes the unit 3 tiles back.

[b]E[/b] - Caught: Throws his web in one direction and brings back the first unit hit. It can send the unit back to a tile and inflict physical damage.

[b]R[/b] - Weaving spider: Place an invisible weaving spider. When a unit steps on it, it is trapped and suffers elemental damage.

[h2]Adnar[/h2]
[b]Passive[/b] - Striking speed: Adnar's damage is increased by his extra velocity.

[b]Q[/b] - Ambidextrous strike: Strikes the target twice, dealing physical damage and reducing his healing. If Adnar is invisible, it also applies bleeding.

[b]E[/b] - Infectious Poison: Inflicts physical damage and poison for each bleed on the target. If Adnar is invisible, he can charge at the target or at an empty tile.

[b]R[/b] - Perfect camouflage:
[u]Passive:[/u]
If Adnar is invisible, he retains his camouflage even if he leaves the square where he became invisible. When he is not invisible, he gains velocity.
[u]Active:[/u]
Sends a smoke to the area around him, All affected units become invisible and incapacitated as long as they remain in the smoke.

[h1]New assets[/h1]
New boosters have also been added to allow you to explore new strategies and thus diversify your games. There are :

[b]Item Horn[/b] - The cooldown of your items is reduced to 0 and you gain a charge on each consumable.

[b]Investor[/b] - When you have less Khinas than your opponent, the chests give you extra Khinas.

[b]Bloodthirster[/b] - When one of your units kills an opponent unit, it recovers health points.

[b]Preparation[/b] - When you have less Khinas than your opponent, you get a consumable item each offensive turn.

[b]Protected opening[/b] - When one of your units captures a chest, it gets a shielded.

[b]Maxmimum Health III[/b] - Your units gain extra life. They regain a small number of health points each turn.

[b]Shield of Prince Lothys[/b] - You get the mythical item, the Shield of Prince Lothys. It reduces the damage taken by units around the wearer. If you use the item, the wearer gets a shield that can block heavy damage.

[b]Sword of Amanaka[/b] - You get the mythical item, the Sword of Amanaka. Grants physical mastery, hit points and piercing resistance to the wearer. When used, inflicts damage to affected units. If these units die from the blow, the wearer obtains permanent physical mastery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/7761a5726e40b210d638f105b8cb93853f664c0a.gif[/img]

[h1]New features[/h1]
Some gameplay features have been changed as well. We hope you will like this upgrades, do not hesitate to give us your feedback about those on our Discord server.

[b]Unlimited inventory[/b] - The loot window has been removed in favor of an unlimited inventory that you can expand when you want to see and equip your extra items.

[b]Blocking[/b] - Chest channeling can no longer be interrupted if damage is absorbed by a block. If the damage exceeds the remaining shield, the unit will still be interrupted.

[b]Duration effect calculations[/b] - The calculation of duration effect control ratios has been revised to be more accurate.

[b]Interface window status[/b] - The "Bonus/Malus" and "Statistics" blocks of the units during a game will keep their open or closed status between games.

[b]Sentinel Luxiole (Adalar)[/b] - The Sentinel Passive Luxiole has a new 3D model.

[b]Draft[/b] - Unit Tooltip on Hover: Hovering over units during the draft phase will now display their skill details.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
And finally, as always, we have fixed various bugs you may have reported to us via on our Discord server.

[b]Traps[/b] - Ground objects such as Luxiole (Sentinel) or Chests will destroy the traps they are placed on.

[b]Blocking[/b] - Shields will no longer absorb damage from effects over time on the turn after the blocking ends.

[b]Tile Conflicts[/b] - Units now suffer the strength of the unit that pushed them, not their own strength, in case of a tile conflict.

[b]Akuyandi E[/b] - "Heave Ho!" Now inflicts the intended damage of the skill, not the strength of the unit being pushed.

[b]Mastok E[/b] - Mighty Slow: Now deals the intended damage of the skill, not Mastok's strength.

[b]Chaksa R[/b] - A Lothys Retaliation: Rooting can now be purged.

[b]Irisha E[/b] - Toxic Surprise: Landing on an anemone after a jump or push will no longer send the unit into slide past the battlefield.

[b]Kaya E[/b] - Glue: Fixed a bug that prevented the "Flammable" state from spreading burns properly on targets that were wet.

[b]Sinna R[/b] - Barf: Fixed a visual bug that constantly displayed the R "Herb Feed" icon even when R "Fish Feed" was active.

[b]Movement[/b] - Fixed several bugs with move skills and moves that could result in units not being playable or being saved on the wrong tile.

[b]Options[/b] - Closing options on a tab other than "Graphics" no longer displays an empty page when the options are reopened.

Thanks again for your support and feedback, we hope you like what you've just read!
In the meantime, we'll see you on Noara's land.

The Atypique Studio team

notes.title: Patch Notes #1.7.0.7

notes.title: Patch Notes #1.5.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We hope you are well! Before the launch of the Ladder Rush Challenge for the month of May, here is the 1.5.0 update of Noara which brings several improvements, bug fixes and new content additions.


[h2][b]New features[/b][/h2]

[b]Ladder Rush mode[/b]
We have added a special "Ladder Rush" mode so you can join the ranked games for the tournament. This mode of play will be active during the tournament time slots. The cumulative score [i](Points of Honour formerly MMR)[/i] will be reset to zero at the end of each tournament. The top 100 players will be awarded prizes at the end of the tournament.

[i]Find all the information about the tournament here:[/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1101030/view/3174484195258942195

[b]Kalinga[/b]
A new base model [i](rework)[/i] and 2 new skins replace the old version of Kalinga!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/81628334e21505238347d6463dc9ec8ef37d3be7.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes #1.4.7
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In order to keep up with the latest versions of the game we will change the number of the different patch numbers. The patch version 2.1 is changed to patch notes version 1.4.7 which now corresponds to version 1.4.7 of Noara.

[h1]New features[/h1]
[b]2v2 mode[/b]
[u]• Plates:[/u] A plate system has been integrated into the Stronghold and Silo Blockers (amber). This system is designed to reward players who attack the opposing Stronghold or Silo Blockers by giving them Khina based on the damage they inflict on these two structures.
[u]• Stronghold:[/u] When a team removes 20% of life points from the opponent's Stronghold, the two strategists of the team gain 150 Khinas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/e9bbd4435180f1d64950c28fb685c53fc621bd00.png[/img]

[u]• Silo Blockers:[/u] When a team removes 20% of life points from a Silo Blocker, both strategists on the team gain 50 Khinas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/cdc63699124c9fee503ec62ecd83b91963f058ba.png[/img]

[b]Chest[/b]
[u]Central Objective:[/u] We have replaced the cage in the middle of the battlefield with a new objective: the chest. When a team removes 20% of life points from this chest, the two strategists of the team gain Khinas according to the Round in the game (the more the game is advanced, the more the Khinas gained are important. The team that destroys the chest earns twice the amount of Khinas!
As for the cage that it replaces, the chest appears at certain times of the game.
• Frequency of appearance: Round 2 / 6 / 10
• Life points: 500 / 800 / 1100
• Khina gain per plate: 100 / 150 / 200
• Gain of Khinas at destruction: 200 / 300 / 400
• Resistances: 100 physical resistances and 100 elemental resistances

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/1e4633e96d4e9ef5b6cee906ce94e3bb7ddc2a79.png[/img]

[b]Chat[/b]
Added commands in the chat to send and reply to private messages during a game.
• Send a private message:
> /w Pseudo
• Reply to a private message:
> /r


[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[b]Units[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/22134a107945eea9ce24b2a8de06792300ece8b9.png[/img] [u]• Krogz Q "Two Pinches":[/u] The physical mastery ratio is reduced from 30% to 10% per hit and the damage becomes siege damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/f8e94a2f6a61247cd29c605ba7224cbb4008f72a.png[/img] [u]• Silicia:[/u] Her health points increase from 800 to 900 [i](Skirmish)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/f8e94a2f6a61247cd29c605ba7224cbb4008f72a.png[/img] [u]• Opie&Jake Q "Frog Hop":[/u] Damage dealt increases from 100 to 120 [i](Skirmish)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/f8e94a2f6a61247cd29c605ba7224cbb4008f72a.png[/img] [u]• Sentinel Q "Javelin":[/u] Damage done increases from 40 to 80 [i](Skirmish)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/f8e94a2f6a61247cd29c605ba7224cbb4008f72a.png[/img] [u]• Guttsie Q "Harpy Shot":[/u] Damage increased from 150 to 200 [i](Skirmish)[/i]

[b]Items[/b]
[i](Skirmish)[/i] [u]"PufferFish":[/u] The item is replaced by the item "Grapple".


[h1]Bugfix[/h1]
[b]Localization[/b]
Correction of localization errors in different languages. 

[b]General[/b]
[u]• Game host:[/u] The game host is now correctly decided based on its ping.
[u]• 2v2 Invitation:[/u] If a person disconnects before accepting a 2v2 game invitation, the invitation will no longer remain pending.
[u]• 2v2 Invitation:[/u] If the invited player accepts an invitation from another player, the pending invitation will be correctly cancelled.
[u]• Game start:[/u] When a player leaves the game while loading, the other players will no longer be stuck on the "Waiting for players" screen.
[u]• Chat:[/u] Making the shortcut associated with opening and closing the chat will have the correct effect on the game's welcome.

[b]Codex[/b]
[u]• Malakaye Q "Colossal Strike":[/u] The video displayed will be that of the skill "Colossal Strike" and not that of the Z "Colossal Roll".
[u]• Babanga W "Round Tripl":[/u] The video displayed is replaced by a Work in progress for the moment.

[b]Units[/b]
[u]• Babanga, Babingi, Chaksa and Sinna Passive "Not Dead Yet!:[/u] The "Embryo available" status icon will be visible when the embryo is available.
[u]• Mana W "Odd Mixture":[/u] Destroying a cage with this skill will result in an item.
[u]• Pirh Engineer W "Springboard":[/u] The maximum distance the Pirh can land a second Unit Launcher will now be correctly displayed in the skill description.
[u]• Irisha W "Toxic Surprise":[/u] Units stepping on a "Toxic Surprise" will now take 30 elemental damage immediately upon stepping on it.

[u]• Alluring Octopus:[/u] Affects affected units correctly even if they are moving.

[b]Fog of War[/b]
When a silo blocker is destroyed, the FX will no longer play in the fog of war.

[b]Puzzle[/b]
[u]• Stealthy:[/u] Babingi will no longer suffer multiple damage and effects when stepping on a locked Kapal.
[u]• Flying Exercise:[/u] Scenarios that caused the player to lose when they should have won have been corrected.


[h1]Visual Bugfix[/h1]
[b]General[/b]
[u]Rank:[/u] Fixed an error in the name of the ranks. Ranks are now as follows:
• 0 -> 399 : Rookie
• 400 -> 799 : Soldier
• 800 -> 1199 : Strategist (formerly Conqueror)
• 1200 -> 1599 : Conqueror (formerly High Tactician)
• 1600 -> 1999 : High Tactician (formerly War Lord)
• 2000+ -> War Lord (formerly Great War Lord)
[u]• Friends List:[/u] Players no longer remain in "Playing" state after a custom game.
[u]• Add to Friend List:[/u] Accepting a friend invitation from an offline player will correctly display them in the friend list.
[u]• Portraits:[/u] When a friend changes their portrait, it is updated correctly in the friends list.

[u]• Tiwangi Passive "Grand Finale":[/u] When he dies, Tiwangi will correctly trigger the animations of affected units.

[b]Items[/b]
[u]• Hydro-jet:[/u] Equipping two Hydro-jets on the same unit will no longer cause visual and audio problems.
[u]• PufferFish:[/u] Fixed the jump height when a unit accesses a water tramp from an adjacent square.

[b]Bastion Abilities[/b]
[u]Monolithic Throw:[/u] Movement/targeting grids are now correctly updated when a rock is destroyed.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES #1.04 [April Fools' Day]
notes.content:
[[i]04/02/22 update: it was definitely an April fool's joke[/i] :D]

Hello everyone!
Lots of new additions to this new patch #1.04, so let's get started right now:

[h2][b]April Event[/b][/h2]
For the month of April, we're introducing a number of random events that can change your gameplay experience and even earn you unique rewards!

[h3][b]Egg Hunt[/b][/h3]
During the course of a game (2v2 or Skirmish, not including custom games), there is a very small chance that an egg will appear on one of the battlefield squares at the start of each team's Offensive Turn. If a unit moves to that square, the player who owns the unit gets the egg.
In addition, there is a very small chance that when using Rajang's Z skill "Fishing Time", one of the options fished may be an egg.
If a player collects 999 eggs during the month of April, they will unlock a unique skin of [b]Akuyandi: Easter Bunny[/b]

[h3][b]Explosive games[/b][/h3]
At the start of a game, there is a chance that all of the items you will be offered during a Management Turn or that you can collect by destroying a cage will be "Ansom Bombs". In addition, bombs can rain down and land on unoccupied squares at any time during an explosive game.
	
[h2][b]Balancing[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Units[/b][/h3]
[u][b]Krogz & Kapal :[/b][/u]
Looking at recent games, we find that the Krogz and Kapal Creatures are not up to par with the other units. So we're going to make a few minor changes to bring them up to date a bit:
• Their purchase limit is increased from 8 to 50 each
• Each time a Krogz or Kapal is purchased, their cost decreases by 10 for the rest of the game.
• Krogz and Kapal are no longer subject to the deployment limit: you can deploy as many as you have.

[u][b]Babanga[/b][/u]
On the other hand, we want to ensure that strategies based only on the mass purchase of Krogz and Kapal can still be effectively countered. So, we are also buffing Babanga:
[u]A "Flying Knee":[/u] To further reward players who manage to chain this attack, the damage dealt increases by 1 for each opponent hit until the end of the turn.

[u][b]Pirh slapper[/b][/u]
[u]R " Galvanizing Strike" :[/u] The skill now also increases the size of the affected Pirh by 10%, up to a maximum of 450%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/f3508d6c4242890dd81f67b5e1bdde79a81d3398.png[/img]

[u][b]Kalinga[/b][/u]
With this change on Kalinga, we want to put Akuyandi in the spotlight, because he is still not played enough in our opinion. Moreover, we want to highlight the complicity that these two characters have. 
[u]So, Kalinga has a new Passive:[/u] When Kalinga dies, Akuyandi automatically appears on the bench of the player who owned Kalinga.

[h3][b]Castes[/b][/h3]
In the vein of the Krogz and Kapal creature buff, we are also improving their caste bonuses.
We are reintroducing check insensitivity into creature bonuses. In addition, this control insensitivity will be unlocked once the 2 Creature Bonus is unlocked.

[h3][b]Stronghold[/b][/h3]
After several observations, it seems that the games are still a bit too long. So we have changed the life points of the Bastion so that it can be destroyed more quickly:
• Bastion hit points reduced from 700 to 350.

To compensate for this, and because we want to put the Bastion Upgrades back into the gameplay, we've made some changes to this one:
• [u]Bastion Upgrade 1:[/u] Has been removed from the game.
• [u]Bastion Upgrade 2:[/u] Has been removed from the game.
• [u]Bastion Upgrade 3:[/u] Removed from the game.

[h2][b]Fix[/b][/h2]
• Fixed a bug where sometimes the player [b]Majhinell could win games[/b].
• Fixed a bug where sometimes the bot [b]Penguin could lose games[/b].
• Fixed a bug that allowed to win the game by writing "/win" in the chat.
• Fixed a bug that prevented Namleh from touching himself with his R. 
• Fixed a bug that allowed players to exceed 2000 MMR. As a result, the MMR of all players above 2000 has been reduced to 404.

[h2][b]Collection tab[/b][/h2]
We wanted to innovate, even in the shop! So we created a brand new concept of character skins: [b]common skins[/b].
So, we are proud to present you the first skin of its kind, common to Krogz and Akuyandi: 

[u][b]Krakuyandi[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/133a9b924a54ce01cd0557798904aa46b617ecd9.png[/img]
This skin is now available in the shop (collection tab)! It's up to you to use it strategically to disguise the real King and fool your opponent!
	
[h2][b]Game mechanics change[/b][/h2]
Finally, following feedback from many Fortnite players who didn't like the "Top View" aspect of the game, we're ending this patchnote with a big announcement:  [b]we are proud to announce that Noara will now be in TPS (Third Person Shooter) mode[/b]. 
We are currently working on this change, but here is what we can already tell you:
- The turn-based mode has been kept, allowing us to keep the strategic aspect at the heart of Noara's gameplay.
- We already have a few visuals to whet your appetite.

[previewyoutube=IU1MRdyYXnc;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you'll enjoy these many changes, see you soon on the Lands of Noara!

Hello Strategists!
Today marks the beginning of a [b]new era[/b] for Noara: The Conspiracy. As announced last week, the game is now available for free to allow more players to discover it and expand the community. • Boosters: A new game mechanic giving you the tools to define and adapt your strategy. During the game, with your ally, you will be able to choose a tactical advantage that will bring you permanent bonuses. Choose them well! 
• New victory condition: In order to win, in addition to the destruction of the opponent's stronghold, the team having accumulated the most wealth at the end of round 15 will secure an economic victory.
• Addition of 5 new units in 1V1: A new clan has appeared, the Adalar. Their fighting style will satisfy the most cunning strategists. 
• Collection tab: Customize your army by obtaining skins for your units in-game through the Collection tab. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1101030/view/3090038532601351409]Find here the complete patch note and its summary in video.[/url]

We hope that many of you will play this new update, we look forward to your suggestions!

notes.title: Update #2.0 - New Era
notes.content:

notes.title: Major Announcement: Free To Play Upcoming!
notes.content:
Hello to you strategists!

[i][b]Noara: The Conspiracy[/b][/i] has been in early access on Steam for 4 months now and we would like to thank our community for the constructive feedbacks we have received.
These have allowed us to make fixes, gameplay improvements and new features to bring an even more fun experience to our players.

The feedback from the community is not only about the gameplay but also about the business model. The "Free-To-Play" model has been suggested to us by many of you and even by some of the press. 

After full consideration, this solution appeared to be the best for the future of the game. We therefore announce that as of March 17, 2022, [i][b]Noara: The Conspiracy[/b][/i] will see a major update with additions already announced in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1101030/view/3090035994575198664]this news[/url] and will enter a new era by becoming Free-to-Play.

We've come up with some answers to questions you're probably already asking yourself:

[b]1/ I bought the game, what do I get in return?[/b]
This path taken during these 4 months would obviously not have been possible without you who supported us. So do not worry, all the people who owned the game before the switch to Free to Play will get the [b]Founder’s Pack[/b] content: 
- An exclusive skin of King Akuyandi 
- An exclusive portrait of King Akuyandi
- 3500 Sarme Coins to use in the in-game shop

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985458/7d35d92b275804f8c35738ef9c6d352378ecff2c.png[/img]

[b]2/ Will there be paid gameplay content? [/b]
For those who know us well, this solution is not in line with our vision of video games. Therefore, the answer is no. There will be no paid gameplay content. There wont be any form of pay-to-win in our game. 

[b]3/ If the game is free, how will you make money?[/b]
We believe that the Free-to-Play model is known by many players. There is no surprise that an in-game shop will appear on March 17th. The studio's artistic team has been working hard to bring you quality content in this shop. On this date, you will find 4 units skins, 6 portraits, and a whole bunch of other things that will be added in the coming months.

You probably have many other questions, and we invite you to ask them now in comments. 

The whole Atypique Studio team thanks you for your support!

notes.title: News Dev | Upcoming update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The whole team hopes you are well and ready for a little reading.

As you know, the game started its early access 3 months ago. 3 months during which the team has continued to work hard to give you the best possible gaming experience. 
Today we want to tell you about the current topics in our development, which will appear in the next few weeks in a major update of the game in [b]March[/b].

[h2][b]1. New units. [/b][/h2]
As planned on the roadmap, new units were scheduled for Q1 2022. These will be arriving shortly and include 
- [b]3 new units[/b] that will boost the Kragh clan and increase the possible strategies. 
- Also, [b]5 new Adalar units[/b] will be integrated in the 1v1 mode. This will give you a first idea of the possible strategies in the future.

[h2][b]2. New mechanics[/b][/h2]
We have identified a recurring problem with game length. Some games can be far too long. 
The objective of the Game Design team during the last weeks has been to rework the objectives and the layout of the game mechanics in depth without touching the core gameplay. 
We will then introduce the "[b]Boosters[/b]" mechanic.
Boosters are upgrades you can choose to receive a bonus on some of your units. For example, you can choose between a statistic increase, a random legendary item for each player or 2 caste tomes. 
The choices are of course random and the opposing team will not have the same choices as you. We believe that giving players more tools to turn an advantage into a victory will speed up the pace of the game while preserving the strategic dimension!

[h2][b]3. Balancing and patching[/b][/h2]
We continue to balance the game and fix the bugs we find, largely thanks to you. We take great care with every addition to the game to preserve this balance. 

You know everything now, if you want to help us, write us your questions and comments about the game, it helps us much more than you might think

notes.title: PATCH NOTES #1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
Before we jump into the details of this patch note, the team of Noara wants to wish you a happy new year 2022!

[h2][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h2]
- A new stronghold upgrade is available in the Djakpa shop. Once activated, this upgrade will allow you to deploy your units further away and start fighting quicker.
- We know you wanted an easier way to play with your friends. From now on, you can create customized games for you and your friends without using the matchmaking option.
- At last, there is an action counter integrated in the user interface. As you may have guessed, it counts and shows the number of actions still available in your turn. A left click on it allows you to select a unit with available actions.

[h2][b]UPDATE[/b][/h2]
- [u][b]Rajang:[/b][/u] Some poison FX of the Q spell “Venomous Spit”, W “Fishing Hour” and R “Venomous Charge” have been modified.

-  We have added new sound effects and corrected some others
- The team have worked on optimizing some visual effects in order to improve in-game performances 

[h2][b]FIXES & BALANCING[/b][/h2]
[u][b]Units & Castes[/b][/u]
- Some units could be blocked after using a moving skill. This has been corrected. 
- Dodging the W “Big-Game Fishing”  will display the floating text “Dodge”.
- The bonus effect of the R skill “Spa Treatment” can’t be interrupted when the 3 stacks have been used. 
- Following a change on the damage calculation, Namleh will deal less damage on his Q “Incredible Shot”

notes.title: PATCH NOTES #1.1
notes.content:
[h2][b]RANKING[/b][/h2]
For those who have seen the Roadmap, the ladder and matchmaking are planned for Q2 2022, but we wanted to give you a little surprise before the holidays! 

Please note that this is not the first season. With the ladder up early, we will also be able to make some tests to make sure everything is working properly, especially the matchmaking, and the ladders will be reset quite frequently.

Here's how the ladder will work: 
- Everyone starts with 0 MMR
- Ranks are available at every 100 MMR level! You'll all start as "Rookie IV", and work your way up to "Rookie I" before changing ranks. We let you find out what happens next :)
- You will face enemies close to your MMR. However, if no players of your level are available, you will quickly find players of lower or higher levels. Your MMR gain will of course be adjusted accordingly.


[h2][b]BUG FIX[/b][/h2]
The release of the first patch note unfortunately caused some bugs, so we worked on fixing them. 
- Fixed the bug that sometimes prevented the selection of items or bastion abilities during management turns.
- Using Nariah's W in a bush was preventing your units from using their skills. This is normally a thing of the past!
- Some errors were found in the texts of the « Arm wrestling », they have been corrected.


[h2][b]BALANCE[/b][/h2]
[b][u]Namleh Nerf[/u][/b]
We had a heavy hand on Namleh, who found himself on the top of the list of most purchased characters. A small change was necessary:
Reduction of the elemental mastery ratio of Q from 75% to 50%.

[b][u]Creatures Up[/u][/b]
Creatures were rebalanced a few weeks ago to reduce their impact in game. With the new system of cages, creatures have become even less useful. We have therefore decided to increase the survivability of creatures:

[b][u]Krogz Up[/u][/b]
Maximum Life from 130 to 150
Physical Resistance increased from 30 to 50

[b][u]Kapal Up[/u][/b]
Maximum life from 120 to 140

[b][u]Wasabi Up[/u][/b]
Wasabi is hard to get but didn't seem rewarding enough. 
Q's damage increased from 150 to 200


[h2][b]SOUND DESIGN[/b][/h2]
Wasabi recently got a new model, but its sound design was not yet finished. It is now done!

notes.title: PATCH NOTES #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone :)
We have listened to your feedback on the game and we thank you for it! The whole team has been working hard to add new content and fix as many bugs as possible in the time available. Here is the very first patch of Noara :


[h2][b]A NEW GAME MODE [/b][/h2]
As you know, we announced a 1v1 mode in the road map for Q1 2022. However, many of you have been asking for this mode and we wanted to make you happy.
So we worked on a temporary mode, which is not the real 1v1 mode, but a mode we called "skirmish" which will allow you to play against your friends in one-on-one on a new map with very fast paced game turns.
[b]The goal of the game is simple: kill the opposing king![/b]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40985458/b42817c340f3e66b09ea98083e4663e4847528ff.png[/img]

[b][u]Matchmaking:[/u][/b]
We are aware that it is currently difficult to find games. In order to alleviate this problem, we have worked on matchmaking: 
- The "2v2 - Solo" and "2v2 - Team" queues are now merged to make it easier for players to find games.

[b][u]Interface: Menu[/u][/b]
- Added an FX around the invite button to make it more visible. 
- The waiting counter was blocked at 1 / 4 permanently, no matter how many players were looking for a game. This is now functional, the counter updates as required.

[b][u]Interface: In Game[/u][/b]
- We've made a colour change to the time counter (which is on the bottom right of the HUD) to make it easier to understand which round we're in.
[list][*][u]"Offensive Turn"[/u] with blue counter.
[*][u]"Defensive Turn"[/u] with a red counter.
[*][u]"Management Turn"[/u] with an orange counter.[/list]
- In the same way, we have changed the colour of the life bar of the selected enemy units (block on the top right). The bars of allied units remain green, and those of enemy units become red.
- Added "Cursor Containment" option in the options allowing the mouse cursor to stay on the screen if checked.

[b][u]Chat: In Game[/u][/b]
- Various adjustments have been made to the Chat (cursor positioning, scrollbar, display time) and its visual has been modified.

[b][u]"Tutorial":[/u][/b]
While waiting for a proper tutorial, we have grouped the 5 mini-quests to make a kind of "mini-tutorial".

[b][u]Puzzle:[/u][/b]
- Following numerous requests, the time limit for a turn on most puzzles has been set to infinite!
- Visual improvement of the obstacles in the puzzles "Felt Steps" and "Water Tramp".

[b][u]Localization:[/u][/b]
- Translation of sentences that were always in French in the English version of the game.


[h2][b]2v2 MODE[/b][/h2]
[b][u]Map Improvements:[/u][/b]
- New FX have been added to the Fog of War.
- Visual improvement of the Water Tramp (texture + VFX).
- Sound effects problems in the bushes have been fixed.

[b][u]Cages changed:[/u][/b]
- Cages now have classic hit points and not "per hit" hit points.
- When destroyed, cages no longer offer units but items.
- Added an FX to the destruction of a Cage.

[b][u]Silos:[/u][/b]
Add FX + SFX to the construction, improvement, and destruction of Silos

[b][u]Stronghold:[/u][/b]
Added FX + SFX to the upgrade and destruction of the stronghold.

[b][u]Minimap:[/u][/b]
Added a ping on the minimap (and its SFX) when our unit or our teammate's unit is attacked. Also when one of our silos or our stronghold is attacked.

[b][u]End of the game:[/u][/b]
When either team's stronghold is destroyed, the camera now moves to that stronghold before the Victory/Defeat screen appears. This will help you understand how you lost the game!

[b][u]End of Game Screen:[/u][/b]
The Victory/Defeat screen has been completely redesigned.


[h2][b]UNITS[/b][/h2]
[b][u]General:[/u][/b]
- The end of a skill rolled by a unit no longer interferes with the display of a stronghold ability grid.
- If a unit dies while performing a skill, the skill is now properly interrupted.
- Fixed the bug related to the use of bumpers. A unit that is on a bumper and gets pushed will no longer suffer an automatic jump at the end of the bumper's maximum activation time.
- Fixed the bug where a unit would get stuck following a move skill interrupted by a push.
- Right-click now allows to cancel the selection of a selected skill.
- Up to 10 units can now be deployed instead of 8.
- Changed the display of invisible units so that their silhouettes can no longer be seen by opponents.
- Changed the skill icons for Mogsy, Irisha, Tiwangi and Sinna. 

[b][u]Babingi, Babanga, Chaksa and Sinna's passive: "That didn’t kill!":[/u][/b]
Embryo duration is no longer counted on Management turns.

[b][u]Babingi: R "Break Time":[/u][/b]
The fish remains visible for longer once it has landed on the square.

[b][u]Gakpé W: "Healing Bolt":[/u][/b]
Visual improvement of the FX.

[b][u]Mana: W "Odd Mixture":[/u][/b]
The visual effects of the skill now differ depending on the Mana passive.

[b][u]Rajang: W "Fishing Hour":[/u][/b]
Rajang's W now correctly deals damage to cages.

[b][u]Rajang: R "Venomous Charge":[/u][/b]
- Rajang's R no longer affects Nariah and does no damage to her (see Nariah's passive).
- The skill no longer applies the poison puddle if Rajang is pushed along.

[b][u]Sinna: R "Mephitic Belch / Herbal Belch":[/u][/b]
The damage bonus calculation for "Mephitic Belch" and " Herbal Belch " is now done on the final damage, not the base damage of the skill.

[b][u]Kalinga: Q "Deadly Waltz":[/u][/b]
Kalinga's Q now correctly deals enhanced damage when invisible.

[b][u]Kalinga: R "Dark of Night":[/u][/b]
Fixed the bug that was blocking Kalinga when she used her R as the opposing team passed their turn.

[b][u]Kapal : R “Enlisement” :[/u][/b]
- The skill is now correctly interrupted if Kapal suffers the "Revealed" effect.
- Fixed the bug that caused the game to crash when a unit bounced off a buried Kapal

[b][u]Nariah: W "Visco-slide":[/u][/b]
A unit being purged, while on a poison puddle created by Nariah's W, will suffer the effects of the poison again at the start of the next turn, even if it has not moved from the puddle.

[b][u]Wasabi:[/u][/b]
Did you get tired of the little orange man as Wasabi? We are too!
We're adding a new 3D model to Wasabi. But be aware that it will be further improved later on, it's only temporary!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40985458/235c240075d90b1f43552780232f7648bad08ab3.png[/img]

[b][u]Irisha: Nerf[/u][/b]
Q "Toxic Anemones": 
- Irisha's Q changed: no longer inflicts the "Handicap" effect if the target avoided at least 1 of the 3 projectiles.
W " Toxic Presents ": 
- Irisha's W is both very strong and very frustrating. A little nerfing is in order!
- The anemone now only has 2 HP instead of 3. 
- The damage suffered by the unit in the trap is reduced from 20/30/40/50 to 30/40/50.

[b][u]Rajang: Nerf[/u][/b]
Rajang's gameplay seems to be very popular with players, which we are of course pleased about. On the other hand, his damage is far too high. Rajang therefore goes through the nerf.
Q "Venomous Spit": 
- Elemental Mastery ratio increases from 120% to 100%.
- Elemental Mastery to Poison effect ratio reduced from 50% to 30%.
W "Fishing Hour": 
- Eel and lamprey base damage increased from 80 to 40.
- The Elemental Mastery ratio on Eel is increased from 100% to 80%.
- The physical control ratio for lamprey is reduced from 100% to 80%.
- Physical Mastery ratio on the lamprey's bleed effect increases from 50% to 30%.

[b][u]Namleh: Up[/u][/b]
Poor Namleh hasn't really been popular since the beginning of early access, so we had to give him a "little" boost.
Q " Incredible Shot ": 
- Elemental Mastery ratio increases from 25% to 75%.

[b][u]Demolisher: Up[/u][/b]
Did you know that? There is a unit called "Demolisher"! It is obtained by unlocking the last level of the "Demolisher" caste. We ask because we never see it on the battlefield. Here's a cool up that might make you want to meet her.
Q " Stone Put ": 
- Damage increases from 200 physical damage to 250 base physical damage.
Range increases from 6 to 8.
R " Stone Put ": 
- Damage increases from 200 physical damage to 250 base physical damage.
Range increases from 6 to 8.


[h2][b]CASTS[/b][/h2]
[b][u]King:[/u][/b]
The "+0 HP" healing bonus is no longer displayed above newly deployed units.

[b][u]Demolisher :[/u][/b]
- The bonus 5 that allows you to get the "Demolisher" unit is moved. You now only need 3 demolisher caste units to get the catapult!
- The old 3 demolisher bonus now unlocks when you deploy 6 demolisher caste units.


[h2][b]ITEMS[/b][/h2]
[b][u]General :[/u][/b]
The blinding effect no longer impacts the passive effects of objects.

[b][u]Attractive Octopus:[/u][/b] 
- New VFX added.
- Can now hit cages (damage them, but not move them).

[b][u]Balloon-Fish:[/u][/b]
Visual improvement to the 3D object.

[b][u]Hydro-Jet:[/u][/b]
The water dash effect no longer starts from the last position the item was used.

[b][u]Scooting Kit:[/u][/b]
Improved VFX.

[b][u]Spyglass:[/u][/b]
Improved VFX.

[b][u]Ansom Steam Bomb:[/u][/b]
- The bomb can now be moved by the item "Fishing Net", by Iwobi's Z-skill "Big Game Fishing" and by the item "Shattering Hammer".
- The bomb now does the correct damage even when it explodes next to a cage.

[b][u]Throwing weight:[/u][/b]
The item can no longer target allied units.


[h2][b]STRONGHOLDING SKILLS[/b][/h2]
[b][u]Bat Swarm:[/u][/b]
The cooldown malus now only applies to available defensive skills.

[b][u]CarnardAir:[/u][/b]
Visual rendering has been improved.

[b][u]Sand Wave:[/u][/b]
VFX is now oriented correctly.

[b][u]Stuning Gong:[/u][/b]
The VFX is now oriented correctly.

[b][u]Cry of Support (in-game "Kragh Wrath"):[/u][/b]
The passive Shout of Support buff now triggers properly for every Shout of Support present on the Bastion.

[b][u]Monolithic Throw:[/u][/b]
Boulders placed on squares now have classic hit points instead of "per hit" hit points.

notes.title: HOTFIX #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
One Hotfix per week, we're hot!

[h2][b]Units[/b][/h2]

[b][u]Krogz: Nerf[/u][/b]
The Krogz is the cheapest unit in the game and some say it is the strongest. We need to change that!

[b][u]Gakpe : Up[/u][/b]
Our dear Shaman does not give whole satisfaction, especially considering his high cost. Here's a little boost for him:

Q: Improved impact damage: 20 -> 35.
     Improved burn dots: 30 per turn -> 45 per turn.

[b][u]Namleh: Up[/u][/b]

[b][u]Iwobi: Up[/u][/b]

[b][u]Sawangi: Up[/u][/b]

[b][u]Malakaye: Up[/u][/b]

[b][u]Akuyandi: Up[/u][/b]

[h2][b]Castes [/b][/h2]

[u][b]Creatures: Nerf[/b][/u]
Despite the first nerf, our beloved creatures are still rampant in the Lands of Noara. 
To preserve the balance of the ecosystem, we must crack down again! 

[i]Bonus 8: [/i]
Healing Malus: 50% -> 25%.

[i]Bonus 12 : [/i]
Damage bonus: +30% -> 15%.
Bonus velocity: +3 -> 2
Immunity to checks: -> Creatures are no longer immune to checks


[b][u]Wrestlers : Nerf[/u][/b]
Wrestlers bring important bonuses to all allied units. Too much for our taste! 

[i]Bonus 2:[/i]
+60 VP max for all -> 45 VP max for all
+30 Physical Mastery -> 20 Physical Mastery

[i]Bonus 4:[/i]
+180 VP max for all -> 100 VP max for all
+90 Physical Mastery -> 60 Physical Mastery


[b][u]Fishermen : Nerf[/u][/b]
The Fishermen are essential to the survival of the Kragh clan and we want them to remain so. But the current bonuses are too high and deserve to be reduced. 

[i]Bonus 4: [/i]
Heals 60 HP each round -> Heals 45 HP. 
+70 to resistances -> + 50 resistances.


[b][u]Singular: Up[/u][/b]

+20% damage to units with less than 50% life -> +20% damage to units with less than 60% life.

+60% damage to units with less than 50% life -> +50% damage to units with less than 70% life.

+20% chance to scare target while attacking -> +25% chance to scare target while attacking.


[h2][b]Stronghold Skills[/b][/h2]

Even if we like the mechanics, the horn is very / too advantageous for the team that owns it. So we're going to think about the best way to offer it to you. 
In the meantime, it becomes a "legendary" stronghold skill.

[b][u]Catapult Shot: Nerf [/u][/b]
We are not happy with Catapult Shot. This stronghold skill rewards the team too much for using it, even though it costs nothing and requires no skill. We will change this skill in general terms in the future. 
In the meantime, we will settle for a simple nerf:
The ability becomes a "legendary" Bastion skill.

[b][u]Ballista Shot: Nerve [/u][/b]
We no longer want this skill to be usable against the opposing stronghold.


[h2][b]Items[/b][/h2]

[b][u]Armoured Boots made of sarme:[/u][/b] Up
Velocity: +1 -> +3


[h2][b]Gameplay[/b][/h2]

It is no longer possible to "redistribute" bastion items and skills during management turns. We will reinstate this feature when we have made the changes we want to make to it.

notes.title: HOTFIX #1 | OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone !
We are sincerly grateful for all the games you already played and all your feedback about Noara.
You have to know that we listened to all of your proposal and we are already working on the fixes.
We are aware there are still many bugs and things to fix but we wanted to do a first quick hotfix.


[h2][b]Castes and units[/b][/h2]Those first days spend on Noara seems to be marked by a "little" total domination from creatures, right ?
Indeed, creatures are the cheepest units in the game and can be deployed in large quantities. So we notice that our young strategists tend to neglect the other units to deploy a lot of our dear little creatures: Krogz and Kapal.
Also its seems to come from the over power of those creatures (cause of their stats and their castes bonus), this added to their large number, creatures stand up with units who are supposed to be a way stronger.
So we offer you the first Nerf of Noara! Here are a bunch of small changes that you will discover below.

[u]Krogz : Nerf[/u]
HP : 200 -> 150
Stock in the shop : 20 -> 8

[u]Kapal : Nerf[/u]
HP : 150 -> 120
Stock in the shop : 20 -> 8

[u]Creatures castes bonus : Nerf[/u]
Bonus distribution : 4 > 8 > 12 -> 6 > 9 > 12
Bonus 6 : +40 physical and elementary mastery / +20 physical and elementary resistance
-> +30 physical and elementary mastery.

[u]Pirh : Nerf[/u]
To standardize with the Krogz and Kapal modification we also downcrease the pirh stock in the shop.
Stock in the shop : 20 -> 12

[u]Chaksa : Nerf[/u]
Chaksa seems to be very popular with the players, and for good reason, she is amazing. Her damages are impressive when she uses her Q then W combo.
By the way, this combo seems to be too easy to use cause the W have no cooldown at all.
So, we proposal a modification of this point to use this combo in proper time and not at each round.
Cooldown of the W : 1 round -> 3 rounds

[u]Rajang : Up[/u]
Rajang looks a bit out of breath, so we are offering an upgrade to his attack range to pick him up a bit.
Range of the Q : 2 -> 3

[u]Demolisher castes : Nerf[/u]
The demolisher castes is doing his job great : destroy the structures. Maybe a bit too much, which can make the outcome of some game a little too brutal. We fixe the bonus bring by the caste to reduce this.
Bonus 1
Damage increase on the structure 50%-> 25%
Bonus 3
Damage increase on the structure 150%-> 75%

[u]Units price : Up[/u]
In order to encourage everyone to discover the more expensive units instead of sticking to small creatures, we are decreasing the price of each units who cost more than 400 Khinas.
Units price higher than 400 Khinas : -100 Khinas


[h2][b]Upgrage of the Stronghold[/b][/h2]
Given the price and the waiting time before the Stronghold upgrade is effective, choose to spend your Khinas in this doesn't seems to be a good investment. We are fixing the price of those Strongholds upgrade to make them more attractive.  

[u]Price of upgrade : Up[/u]
500 > 1000 > 1500 --> 400 > 800 > 1200

[h2][b]Silos[/b][/h2]
Silos objectives are quite hard to defend. Their low HP contribute a lot to this, that's why we are bringing a stat modification to this.

[u]Silos HP : Up[/u]
Level 0 : 100 -> 150
Level 1 : 250 -> 300
Level 2 : 450-> 500
Level 3 : 650-> 700

Also in order to get the more expensive units faster, we are changing the price of silo upgrades.
[u]Price of upgrades : Up[/u]
200 > 350 > 550 > 700 --> 200 > 300 > 500 > 650
